## Welcome to the 6th official WCA competition in Mauritius! ##
This competition counts as **Mauritius Nationals** for 2026, so the winner of each event that is of Mauritian Nationality will be crowned **National Champion**!

I'm visiting from Argentina and would like to give Mauritian speedcubers this competition as a present.
Please refer to the [**"IMPORTANT"**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MauritianOdyssey2024#47771-important) tab or reach me by email if you have any questions.
